name: sentry-wms-mobile
_overridesNote: tar pinned to >=7.5.11 to fix GHSA-83g3-92jg-28cx, GHSA-qffp-2rhf-9h96, GHSA-9ppj-qmqm-q256 (path traversal) which surface in prod tree via expo -> @expo/cli -> tar. @xmldom/xmldom 0.9.12 closes the 0.9.x XML serialization and parser advisories; 0.8.x is EOL at 0.8.10 with no backport. xmldom is reached at build time only (Expo config plugins + plist parsing), not runtime. minimatch stays in the 5.x line to fix its ReDoS cluster while avoiding the minimatch 5 -> 10 API break that eas-cli's transitive tree still assumes. Brace expansion is separately pinned to 2.1.7 for the minimatch tree and 5.0.12 under @oclif/core. js-yaml is pinned to the patched 3.15.2 and 4.3.2 lines. undici 6.29.1, source-map-js 1.2.2, browserslist 4.29.5, node-forge 1.4.2, shell-quote 1.12.0, compression 1.8.2, vite 8.1.6, joi 18.3.1 and zod 4.6.7 close the current high/critical advisories. These are build/test dependencies except when Expo tooling is invoked; they are not bundled into the miniprogram used on site.
